title: Fix Window Stack Active Chrome
description: When changing the active window to another window stack, the previous active tab and fullscreen button maintain their active marker incorrectly.
summary: Multi-tab Mode dock chrome now gates stack-active tab U-cap, cap corner, active grid cell, and maximize control active styling on stackGloballyActive (activeWindowId matches the stack's active tab). Inactive stacks keep secondary chrome even when they still hold a local activeId. Added vitest covering two adjacent multi-tab stacks.
